INSERT INTO campaign ( api_reg_no, title, description, purpose, start_date, end_date, homepage_url, org_name, category, zip_code, address, tel_no, region, goal_amount, status, applied_at ) VALUES
( #{dto.cntrProgrmRegistNo}, #{dto.reprsntSj}, #{dto.rcritSj}, #{dto.rcritPurps}, #{dto.rcritBgnde}, #{dto.rcritEndde}, #{dto.hmpgAdres}, #{dto.rcritrNm}, #{dto.cntrClUpNm}, #{dto.zip}, #{dto.adres}, #{dto.dmstcTelno}, #{dto.rcritArea}, #{dto.rcritGoalAm},
CASE WHEN #{dto.step} IN ('모집중','모집예정','모집완료','사용완료') THEN #{dto.step} WHEN CAST(#{dto.rcritBgnde} AS DATE) > CURDATE() THEN '모집예정' WHEN CAST(#{dto.rcritEndde} AS DATE) < CURDATE() THEN '모집완료' ELSE '모집중' END, #{dto.saveDt} )
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE title = VALUES(title), description = VALUES(description), purpose = VALUES(purpose), start_date = VALUES(start_date), end_date = VALUES(end_date), homepage_url = VALUES(homepage_url), org_name = VALUES(org_name), category = VALUES(category), zip_code = VALUES(zip_code), address = VALUES(address), tel_no = VALUES(tel_no), region = VALUES(region), goal_amount = VALUES(goal_amount), status = VALUES(status), applied_at = VALUES(applied_at)
